bagPolicy.summary: Only clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags no larger than 30 x 15 x 30 cm are allowed. Backpacks are not permitted, and any bag is subject to inspection. Prohibited items can vary by event.

parking.summary: Palacio de los Deportes has an on-site parking lot inside the venue grounds with limited capacity. The cost varies by event.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Palacio de los Deportes. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks are not allowed into Palacio de los Deportes. Prohibited items can vary by event.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Palacio de los Deportes, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Palacio de los Deportes's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Palacio de los Deportes. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Palacio de los Deportes. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
